name: Completed service contacts
numerator_definition: Distinct completed encounter identifiers with an actual signed service/disposition in this period.
denominator_definition: Not applicable: count, not a population rate.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: Exclude drafts, cancellations, appointments and duplicate copies. Remote contacts require actual completed care. This is not unique people; reconcile manual and EMR sources rather than adding them. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Completed encounter register or verified equivalent

name: Distinct patients served within this facility
numerator_definition: Distinct custodian-reviewed local patient links among the qualifying completed contacts.
denominator_definition: Not applicable: count, not a population rate.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: Exclude unresolved links. No addition across facilities, zones or periods without reviewed identity reconciliation. Declare unresolved-link counts in the explanation. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Reviewed patient identity crosswalk and encounter register

name: Completed contacts with a coded clinical condition
numerator_definition: Distinct qualifying completed encounters with at least one clinician-signed condition code from the facility's recorded coding-system/version; count each encounter once.
denominator_definition: Not applicable: count, not a population rate.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: This initial profile selects any valid signed condition code and does not classify a specific disease. Suspected/confirmed status remains in the protected source. Exclude uncoded, voided and draft diagnoses. If the coding system or source is unavailable, report UNKNOWN. This is not disease incidence, prevalence, unique people or diagnostic accuracy. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Signed assessment/diagnosis register, coding-system version and completed encounter register

name: Inpatient deaths by occurrence
numerator_definition: Distinct verified inpatient death dispositions occurring in the period.
denominator_definition: Not applicable: count, not a population rate.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: Exclude community deaths, unconfirmed reports, arrival-dead and duplicate notifications. Not deaths among community residents. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Signed inpatient disposition and death register

name: Institutional inpatient mortality proportion
numerator_definition: Verified inpatient deaths among stays with final death/discharge disposition in the period.
denominator_definition: All eligible final inpatient discharge dispositions including deaths in the same period.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: Exclude transfers out without a final local discharge/death, arrival-dead and open stays from both components. Show case mix and incomplete dispositions in explanation. Not population mortality; no facility ranking from this alone. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.

name: Care access fulfilment
numerator_definition: Eligible care requests received in this period with the suitable requested service actually delivered by the period-end cut-off.
denominator_definition: All eligible care requests received in this period, including pending or unavailable services at cut-off.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: Exclude duplicates, explicitly ineligible and withdrawn requests, declaring those counts in explanation. Automated acknowledgement is not care. Late outcomes enter a corrected version of this cohort. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.

name: Unmet suitable-care requests
numerator_definition: Distinct eligible requests received in this period still unfulfilled at cut-off because suitable capacity or capability was unavailable.
denominator_definition: Not applicable: count, not a population rate.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: Deduplicate repeated attempts within one request episode. Exclude patient withdrawal, ineligibility and requests merely awaiting review; disclose pending separately. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.

name: Continuity tasks completed by deadline
numerator_definition: Required follow-up or result tasks due in the period with independently evidenced completion no later than their recorded deadline.
denominator_definition: All required follow-up or result tasks whose recorded deadline falls in the period, including overdue and nonresponding cases.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: Reminder delivery, message opening and patient nonresponse do not establish completion. Exclude a task only with documented cancellation authority, disclosed in explanation. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Clinical task due-times and completion evidence

name: Planned service windows actually covered
numerator_definition: Approved service windows in the period covered throughout by the required privileged team.
denominator_definition: All approved planned service windows in the period, including uncovered windows.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: Count each scheduled service window once; partial staffing is not full coverage. Account count, nominal employment and a directory listing do not demonstrate coverage. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Approved operating windows, duty roster and privilege evidence

name: Current readiness evidence for operating capabilities
numerator_definition: Expected operating capabilities whose required readiness evidence is unexpired at period end.
denominator_definition: All capabilities expected to operate at the period-end review, including those with absent or expired evidence.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: An as-of measure: do not sum across months. Readiness is not licence, guaranteed future availability, accepted referral or quality certification. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Capability catalogue and time-bounded readiness assertions

name: Referral requests receiving actual acceptance
numerator_definition: Eligible referral requests created in the period with recorded receiving-team acceptance by the period-end cut-off.
denominator_definition: All eligible referral requests created in the period, including declined, unreachable and pending requests.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: A sent message, directory match or transport booking is not acceptance. Exclude documented duplicates or withdrawal before review and disclose them. Late acceptance corrects the same cohort. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Referral requests and receiving acceptance receipts

name: Referral outcomes verified by due date
numerator_definition: Referrals due for outcome in the period with verified receiving outcome recorded by their due date.
denominator_definition: All referrals whose recorded outcome deadline falls in the period, including overdue and lost-to-follow-up cases.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: Acceptance, transport and travel are not completed care. Keep unknown, declined and pending outcomes visible; no patient-identifying narrative in returns. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Accepted handover, receiving outcome and due-date register

name: Critical results with required human follow-through
numerator_definition: Critical results with required acknowledgement and action completed by their policy-derived deadline falling in the period.
denominator_definition: All critical results whose required action deadline falls in the period under the actual local critical-result policy.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: Delivery receipt is not clinical acknowledgement. Include overdue and missing actions; if no approved flag/deadline policy exists report UNKNOWN, not zero. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Critical flags, approved local policy and acknowledgement/action receipts

name: Essential product-days with confirmed stockout
numerator_definition: Distinct required essential-product and operating-day pairs during the period with verified usable stock unavailable for any required service interval.
denominator_definition: Not applicable: count, not a population rate.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: One product-day once regardless of repeated attempts. Quarantined or uncertain stock is not usable; disclose uncertainty separately. Not number of patients harmed or a population rate. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Locally approved essential-product list, stock ledger and physical checks

name: Staffed qualified bed occupancy
numerator_definition: Occupied minutes in eligible staffed qualified beds during the period.
denominator_definition: Available staffed qualified bed-minutes during the same period.
population_definition: The selected reporting unit and half-open occurrence period [start, end), using its recorded reporting timezone. Each underlying event is included once in this stream.
inclusion_exclusion: Exclude closed/unqualified beds from both components and document closures. Reservations are not occupancy. Do not use licensed bed count as staffed capacity; unknown capacity means unavailable ratio. Missing or unreliable sources are UNKNOWN/MISSING/PARTIAL with explanation; zero is explicit NIL only after source review. No patient identifiers in aggregate references.
source_register: Timestamped occupancy and staffed-bed capacity ledger
